function.name: tool_getProducts
function.description: Search for products in the database by ID, reference code, name, or price range. Use wildcards (@) for partial matching. Returns matching products with their ID, Reference, Name, and Sale_Price. Results can be sorted by any field and limited to a maximum number. Returns a counts object with total, totalFiltered, and totalSent to indicate if results were truncated. If ID is provided, it performs a direct lookup before applying other filters.

ID.description: Product ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search by other criteria. When provided, searches for this specific product first, then applies other filters.

Reference.description: Product reference code. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: 'PRD@' matches all references starting with PRD. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

Name.description: Product name. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: '@laptop@' matches any product name containing 'laptop'. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

min.description: Minimum sale price (inclusive). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

max.description: Maximum sale price (inclusive). Defaults to 999999 if not provided.

field.description: Field name to sort by. Valid values: ID, Reference, Name, Sale_Price. Defaults to 'Name' if not provided.

order.description: Sort order. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' if not provided.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. If not provided, defaults to the system's defaultTop limit. Use this to limit large result sets. The response will include counts object showing if results were truncated.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only count information (total, totalFiltered, totalSent) without entity data, saving tokens. When false or omitted, returns full entity data. Use this when you only need to know how many entities match the criteria, not the actual data.

x-examples.description: Search for products with names containing 'computer' in the price range 500-2000
Search for all products with reference starting with 'ELEC'

function.name: tool_getClients

Returns matching clients with their ID, Name, Contact, City, State, Country, Discount_Rate, Total_Sales, and Comments. Results can be sorted by any field and limited to a maximum number. Returns a counts object with total, totalFiltered, and totalSent to indicate if results were truncated. If ID is provided, it performs a direct lookup before applying other filters.

ID.description: Client ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search by other criteria. When provided, searches for this specific client first, then applies other filters.

Name.description: Client name. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: '@Smith@' matches any client name containing 'Smith'. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

Contact.description: Contact person name. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: '@John@' matches any contact name containing 'John'. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

min.description: Minimum total sales amount (inclusive). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

max.description: Maximum total sales amount (inclusive). Defaults to 9999999 if not provided.

field.description: Field name to sort by. Valid values: ID, Name, Contact, City, State, Country, Discount_Rate, Total_Sales, Comments. Defaults to 'Name' if not provided.

order.description: Sort order. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' if not provided.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. If not provided, defaults to the system's defaultTop limit. Use this to limit large result sets. The response will include counts object showing if results were truncated.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only count information (total, totalFiltered, totalSent) without entity data, saving tokens. When false or omitted, returns full entity data. Use this when you only need to know how many entities match the criteria, not the actual data.

function.name: tool_getInvoices
function.description: Search for invoices in the database by invoice number, client ID, creation date range, or total amount range. Use wildcards (@) for partial matching. Returns matching invoices with their ID, Invoice_Number, Client_ID, Creation_Date, Paid status, Payment_Date, and Total. Results can be sorted by any field and limited to a maximum number. Returns a counts object with total, totalFiltered, and totalSent to indicate if results were truncated. If Client_ID is provided and not 'any', it filters invoices for that specific client.

Invoice_Number.description: Invoice number. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: 'INV@' matches all invoice numbers starting with INV. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

Client_ID.description: Client ID to filter invoices. Use 'any' or omit to search invoices from all clients. When provided with a specific ID, only returns invoices for that client.

min.description: Minimum invoice total amount (inclusive). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

max.description: Maximum invoice total amount (inclusive). Defaults to 9999999 if not provided.

min.description: Minimum creation date (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2025-01-01'. Defaults to '2000-01-01' if not provided.

max.description: Maximum creation date (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2025-12-31'. Defaults to '2350-12-31' if not provided.

field.description: Field name to sort by. Valid values: ID, Invoice_Number, Client_ID, Creation_Date, Paid, Payment_Date, Total. Defaults to 'Total' if not provided.

order.description: Sort order. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not provided.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. If not provided, defaults to the system's defaultTop limit. Use this to limit large result sets. The response will include counts object showing if results were truncated.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only count information (total, totalFiltered, totalSent) without entity data, saving tokens. When false or omitted, returns full entity data. Use this when you only need to know how many entities match the criteria, not the actual data.

x-examples.description: Search for invoices with total amount over 1000
Search for invoices from a specific client
Search for invoices with number starting with 'INV2024' and total between 500 and 5000

function.name: tool_getInvoiceLines
function.description: Search for invoice lines in the database by invoice number, invoice ID, client ID, product ID, quantity range, or total amount range. Use wildcards (@) for partial matching on text fields. Returns detailed invoice line items with ID, Line_Number, Invoice.Invoice_Number, Invoice.Client_ID, Total, Quantity, Product.Reference, and Product.Name. Results can be sorted by any field and limited to a maximum number. Returns a counts object with total, totalFiltered, and totalSent to indicate if results were truncated. Useful for analyzing product sales, client purchases, or specific invoice details.

Invoice_Number.description: Invoice number. Supports wildcard matching with @. Example: 'INV@' matches all invoice numbers starting with INV. Defaults to '@' (all) if not provided.

Invoice_ID.description: Invoice ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search across all invoices. When provided, returns only lines from this specific invoice.

Client_ID.description: Client ID to filter invoice lines. Use 'any' or omit to search across all clients. When provided, returns only lines from invoices belonging to this client.

Product_ID.description: Product ID to filter invoice lines. Use 'any' or omit to search across all products. When provided, returns only lines containing this specific product.

min.description: Minimum quantity (inclusive). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

max.description: Maximum quantity (inclusive). Defaults to 9999999 if not provided.

min.description: Minimum line total amount (inclusive). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

max.description: Maximum line total amount (inclusive). Defaults to 9999999 if not provided.

field.description: Field name to sort by. Valid values: ID, Line_Number, Total, Quantity. Defaults to 'Total' if not provided.

order.description: Sort order. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not provided.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. If not provided, defaults to the system's defaultTop limit. Use this to limit large result sets. The response will include counts object showing if results were truncated.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only count information (total, totalFiltered, totalSent) without entity data, saving tokens. When false or omitted, returns full entity data. Use this when you only need to know how many entities match the criteria, not the actual data.

Search for invoice lines from a specific client with quantity over 10

function.name: tool_createInvoice
function.description: Creates a new invoice with invoice lines in the database. Requires a valid Client_ID and at least one invoice line. Each invoice line must reference an existing Product_ID. The function automatically calculates line totals, taxes, and invoice totals. Returns success or error message.

Client_ID.description: Client ID (required). Must exist in the CLIENTS database. The invoice will be created for this client.

Creation_Date.description: Invoice creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2025-11-21'

Paid.description: Payment status. If true, Payment_Date, Payment_Method, and Payment_Reference should be provided.

Payment_Date.description: Payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only relevant if Paid is true. Example: '2025-11-21'

Payment_Method.description: Payment method (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Bank Transfer', 'Check', 'Cash'). Only relevant if Paid is true.

Payment_Reference.description: Payment reference number or transaction ID. Only relevant if Paid is true.

ProForma.description: Whether this is a pro forma invoice (not a final invoice).

Payment_Delay.description: Payment delay in days. Must be 30, 60, or 90 days.

Proforma_Number.description: Pro forma number if this is a pro forma invoice.

Credit_Note.description: Whether this is a credit note (negative invoice).

Lines_Fm_Invoices.description: Array of invoice lines (required). Must contain at least one line.

Product_ID.description: Product ID (required). Must exist in the PRODUCTS database. Product details (reference, name, price, tax rate) will be fetched automatically.

Quantity.description: Quantity of the product (required). Must be a positive integer.

Discount_Rate.description: Discount rate as a percentage (0-100). Typically under 10. Example: 5 for 5% discount.

Create a paid invoice with payment details
